answer: To join, a claimant posts a bond into a canyon escrow locked for three epochs, then publishes an unpaid-work packet: a fresh 256-bit preimage whose hash, XOR-folded with the epoch seed, collides on the leading 20 bits with a randomly assigned incumbent beacon slot. Three established atlas validators must countersign that packet within one epoch. A second preimage mapping to the same slot slashes both the new bond and the prior claimant's remaining lock; an unsigned or late packet forfeits only the new bond, and no miner may attest the claimant until those countersignatures land.
